g.text: Ensembl 110 / GRCh38 gene bodies + transcripts · SCN2A-derived ASOs · ≤3 total edits
Medians and ranges of 3 fresh-process runs; OS cache retained. Loading, output and verification included; index build excluded.
Separate EC2 workers: 8 vCPUs / 4 physical cores; 16 GiB (minimap2: 32 GiB). Recovery is relative to native-positive queries.
Open triangles: timeout lower bounds. OOM is labelled without a timing/recovery estimate. Heuristic comparators may miss witnesses.
